info.name: S&P Global Commodity Insights Authentication Entity Resolution API

items.docs: Resolves one or more entity mentions to their canonical Kensho Entity Identifier (KEID). Accepts entity names, aliases, ticker symbols, CUSIP, ISIN, or other identifiers and returns the canonical entity record.

params.name: keid
params.description: Kensho Entity Identifier (KEID) for the entity

items.docs: Returns the full canonical entity record for a given Kensho Entity Identifier (KEID), including names, aliases, entity type, and cross-references to other S&P Global identifiers.
